22. Merge Fast-forward vs Three-way

SIMPLE ENGLISH
Fast-forward moves a branch ref when its tip is an ancestor of the other tip. A divergent history
needs a merge based on both tips and their common ancestor.
සිංහJලෙන් main එක feature branch එJකේ ancestor නම් pointer එක ඉස්සරහට move කරන්න පුළුවන්.
JදපැතේJතේම commits තිJයනවා නම් common ancestor භාවිත කර merge කරනවා.
Merge a feature with no main changes, then compare a divergent case.

Fast-forward Three-way merge · old main · B · M · main · A B C · A · main + feature · C · feature · Read the diagram: A-B: main; C: feature; Fast-forward main to C; Divergent case creates M. · main එක feature branch එJකේ ancestor නම් pointer එක ඉස්සරහට move කරන්න පුළුවන්. JදපැතේJතේම commits · තිJයනවා නම් common ancestor භාවිත කර merge කරනවා.

git switch main
git merge --ff-only feature/cart
# On a divergent example: git merge feature/cart
Expected: First command succeeds only for fast-forward; divergent merge may create a merge commit.
When does fast-forward fail? When neither current tip is an ancestor of the incoming tip.
